Subject: Partner Center referrals: initial account mapping for Contoso & Avelo

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Partner Center has routed two inbound referrals into our co-sell pool that look like a good fit for Redwood: Contoso (enterprise retail) and Avelo Airlines (travel-tech). I attached the export from Partner Center with the minimal fields — account name, MSRC owner, referral id, high-level notes. Can your team confirm account mapping and a proposed field seller for each?

Quick context: Contoso already expressed interest in a private deployment for sensitive PII workflows; Avelo is evaluating cost/latency for an in-product assistant and wants a short POC and pricing. Both are marked as "Co-sell eligible" in Partner Center.

Attachments: partnercenter-referrals-050920.csv (CSV; columns: referral_id, account, msr_owner, estimated_tcv, notes)

Ask: Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday which Redwood rep will own the field handoff and whether you can start a MAP (mutual action plan) draft for each account? Also flag any deal-level blockers (procurement, security/regulatory).

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Sarah Wong
Partner Program Manager, Microsoft Partner Center
Microsoft Corporation

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Partner Center referrals: initial account mapping for Contoso & Avelo

Sarah — thanks for sending this over. I downloaded the CSV and did an initial pass. High level response below; I'll put together a short MAP template and share by EOD tomorrow.

Preliminary mapping (need confirmation from Karthik on allocated seller capacity):
- Contoso — assign to Marissa (Enterprise AE). Primary ask: Private deployment + SOC2 evidence; procurement timeline ~8–10 weeks.
- Avelo Airlines — assign to Karthik (Strategic Sales). Primary ask: POC on hosted with SLA preview; likely < $50k initial TCV.

Open questions / blockers:
- Contoso: requires code-level network isolation; will likely want Dedicated or Private. Need to confirm whether our Private on-prem package fits their compliance team timelines.
- Avelo: they want benchmark latency in specific AP region (we only have hosted in us-west/eu currently). Confirm appetite for a short Dedicated evaluation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik and Marissa confirm seller availability and add direct seller contact info into the CSV (reply-all with contact emails).
2) I’ll draft two MAPs (one per account) with milestones: Discovery, Security review, POC, Commercial terms, Contract.
3) We’ll coordinate a short triage call with Sarah + MSCo-sell to align handoff and expected timing.

Putting this on my calendar to follow up Tuesday EOD.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Team — summary and proposed execution plan (finalizing MAPs attached). I’m copying Sarah so MSCo-sell has visibility on timeline and seller owners.

Summary of assignments:
- Contoso: Marissa Cole (Enterprise AE). Next step: Marissa to schedule Discovery + Compliance kickoff with Contoso procurement (psales@contoso.com). Target milestone: Security scoping call by 2026-05-19.
- Avelo Airlines: Karthik Iyer (Strategic Sales). Next step: Karthik to sign DocuSign PIA and schedule latency benchmark POC run with engineering. Target milestone: POC kickoff by 2026-05-20.

Mutual Action Plan (attached): MAP sections include owners, milestones, estimated timelines, success criteria, and required artifacts (SOC2, network diagrams, SLA matrix). I attached the two MAPs and a short vendor handbook: MAP-vendor-handbook.pdf.

Operational notes / risks:
- Contoso procurement cycle could extend if they require on-prem deployment. Flag to Solutions Architecture ASAP.
- Avelo needs confirmation about our AP latency; for now we’ll offer hosted in us-west + a dedicated benchmarking window. If they insist on an AP deployment, escalate to Product to evaluate short-term region options.

Immediate asks (please action this week):
1) Marissa: reach out to Contoso procurement and book the Compliance kick-off (add Sarah to invites).
2) Karthik: sign the DocuSign PIA (link provided earlier) and schedule the engineering POC.
3) Marissa/Karthik: add your calendar availabilities for a joint MSCo-sell triage (I propose Thu 2026-05-14 13:00–13:30 PT).

Thanks — I’ll own follow-up and keep the HubSpot record updated.

Attachments: MAP-vendor-handbook.pdf, partnercenter-referrals-050920.csv
